Hey there, developer friends! Welcome to Issue 87 of your favorite weekly dose of developer tooling goodness! 🚀 This week we've rounded up 5 must-see links that will supercharge your workflow, and we are absolutely thrilled to share them with you.

First up, get ready to fall in love with a brand-new Rust linter that catches sneaky bugs before they catch you! 🦀 Next, we're diving into a sleek Git GUI that makes branching, merging, and reviewing commits feel like a breeze. And last but not least, meet a powerful tracing tool that will help you pinpoint performance bottlenecks faster than you can say "stack trace"! 🔍

Whether you're a seasoned pro or just getting started, this week's roundup has something special for you. Grab your favorite beverage, settle in, and let's make your dev life a little easier together!

Join our amazing community of 9,400 subscribers who never miss a beat. Let's dive in! 💻✨
